items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 142:1
items.html: Before the correction of the three worlds BYA, the entire place of BYA was an empty void, because the concluding Malchut beneath the feet of AK ascended to the place of the Chazeh [chest] of the Partzuf TNHYM of AK. And likewise, after the three worlds BYA were corrected, and after they ascended in the third aspect of the world of Assiyah, before the sin, to the YESHSUT and ZON of Atzilut, thirty Sefirot of the place of BYA again remained in the aspects of an empty void, for the BYA had already departed from them. (Item 93).
